status_note: Reproduces on Snowflake 10.40.102, grouped and ungrouped, on `VALUES` and on TPC-H's LINEITEM. The docs do not name the algorithm (https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/functions/var_samp); the results are those of the one-pass textbook formula. Not searched in Snowflake's community forum yet.
summary: `VAR_SAMP`, `VAR_POP`, `STDDEV_*`, `COVAR_*` and `CORR` of `FLOAT` values cancel catastrophically: for `1e9 + {4, 7, 13, 16}` the sample variance is 0.0 where it is 30, and `CORR` with a correlated column is NULL, as if a side were constant. Shifting the data changes the variance (LINEITEM's `l_quantity` gives 208.1, plus 1e9 gives 250.1, plus 1e12 gives 0.0). Welford's update, or a shift by any value of the group, keeps it exact.
handling: sverify's SQL refuses `VAR_*` and `STDDEV_*` of doubles on Snowflake (`SnowflakeDialect.float_var`); it does not write `COVAR_*` or `CORR`. Of `NUMBER` values Snowflake computes exactly to six places.
